item.title: Scenario Planning and Foresight: new challenges, emerging practices, and evolving frontiers
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines scenario planning and foresight as evolving methodologies for anticipating and preparing for future challenges. It addresses contemporary developments in how organizations and societies understand and engage with uncertainty, technological change, and strategic planning.

Appel publié par Technology in Society. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

item.title: Hopeful Futures
item.content:encoded:
This special issue invites submissions exploring how we might prefigure hopeful futures through research, creative practice, and imagination. The call seeks contributions that engage with optimistic visions of tomorrow while grounding these aspirations in rigorous analysis and critical engagement with contemporary challenges.

Appel publié par Futures. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Prefiguration and future studies
  • Hope and optimism in futures research
  • Imagining positive futures
  • Alternative futures scenarios
  • Speculative fiction and futures thinking
